name: Dual-Channel Safety Input Monitoring
description: Two independent safety channels that must both agree. Discrepancy detection triggers fault. Common for light curtains, safety gates.
safety_notes: XOR detects disagreement between channels. Short timer allows for transition delay. Once Safety_Fault latches, requires manual reset and maintenance.
common_mistakes: No discrepancy detection — single point of failure
Too long discrepancy timeout — allows unsafe operation
